mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookmarked_merchants (user_id, merchant_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{merchantId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE bookmarked_merchants SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bookmarked_merchants WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC
